title: Advanced SELECT [HAVING]
description:
## HAVING
`WHERE` filters rows BEFORE grouping. But what if you want to filter AFTER grouping? That's `HAVING`.

```sql
-- WHERE: filter rows first, then group
SELECT status, COUNT(*)
FROM deployments
WHERE status != 'deleted'
GROUP BY status;

-- HAVING: group first, then filter groups
SELECT status, COUNT(*)
FROM deployments
GROUP BY status
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```

`WHERE` = filter individual rows
`HAVING` = filter entire groups
